title: Pat Suzuki's Newport Festival group and other Newport appearances
summary: Jones led a seven-piece band at Newport with Pat Suzuki, Doc Severinsen, and played there with Anita O'Day and Sarah.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Oh, boy. Yeah, now -- that's not in chronological order. That's the reason you see me hesitate, to

try to turn my mind off of out here and go way back to New York. Let's see, Pat Suzuki. Well, this was Doc Severinsen again, was in the band. I was the leader. Yes, I know what it was for. It was for the Newport Jazz Festival. We had about seven pieces, you know, and I had to do some writing for it. And we went up to Newport, you know, with Pat.
So you've played Newport with Pat Suzuki and also with Anita O'Day, you were mentioning.
I don't know. I think I played there several times with Sarah. Because I was with her so long, you know?
